theorem pure_grey (ha : Tendsto (fun i => (m i).val) atTop atTop) (hf : ∀ i, Pointwise (F i))
    (h0 : ∀ i, fderiv ℝ (F i) 0=0) (hs : LawfulSum 3 m F 1)
    {q u : ℝ} (p : Picture G 2) (v : Picture G 3) (hp : ∀ i j, Firm σ A (p i j)) (h : ∀ i, Recorded p (F i) 0)
    (hx : ∀ i j, Firm q u (v i j)) (hv : ∀ i, Recorded v (F i) 0) :
     (∀ i j,Rays 2 (p i j ∘ axes)) ∧ ∀ i j,Rays 1 (v i j ∘ axes) := by

proof_context.conclusion: `pure_grey` upgrades vanishing derivative data on the kernels to `Rays 2` and `Rays 1` along axes.

lemma greyson (G : Gauge) (σ ε C Z τ A : ℝ) (hs : 0<σ) (hC : 0≤C) (hZ : 0≤Z) (hτ : 0<τ) (hA : 0≤A) : ∃ s M,0<s ∧ 0≤M ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ→ Side), Tendsto (fun i => (m i).val) atTop atTop → ∀ (B : Bed) (p : Clip) (R : PathData G) Λ, R.Bounds p τ A Λ → Attached B R → B.metric.strip σ C → p.direct ≤ Z → (∀ n,Floor B p n ε C) → (∀ i,Bid.Sworn B (m i) G) →
    ∀ i, i>0 → i≤3 → Drinkable i m (fun i => intended (m:=m i) p R-WilsonQ G (m i)) (4-i) s M := by

proof_context.conclusion: `greyson` gives difference orders 3, 2, 1 for Wilson degrees 2, 3, 4.
